description:

Panel (b) shows the query stream attention, which lacks access to information about the content. Panel (c) provides an overview of the permutation language modeling training with two-stream attention, including attention masks and a sample factorization order.

caption: Figure 2: Attention patterns shared by XLNet and BERT . Rows and columns represent query and key respectively.
description:
Figure type: Heatmap
Description: The figure shows four heatmaps comparing attention patterns between XLNet and BERT. Each heatmap represents a different attention pattern: (a) Content stripes, (b) Local/Self focus, (c) Two segments, and (d) Content-based symmetry. The rows and columns of each heatmap correspond to query and key positions, respectively.

Text in figure: Content stripes, Local/Self focus, Two segments, Content-based symmetry

caption: Figure 3: Attention patterns that appear only in XLNet . Rows and columns represent query and key respectively.
description:
Description: This figure displays three heatmaps representing attention patterns in XLNet. Each heatmap shows the attention scores between query and key tokens. Panel (a) shows self-exclusion, where attention is low for the same token. Panel (b) shows relative stride, with attention scores decreasing as the distance between tokens increases. Panel (c) shows one-side masked attention, where attention is only present on one side of the mask.
